title: Sonny: The Invisible Business

featured_ai_employee.name: Sonny
featured_ai_employee.claim_scope: Drafts social posts for the owner to review and approve. Nothing is shown as published; no follower, engagement or sales numbers. Demo is a dramatization.

business_problem: Neglected Instagram, no time to post
deliverable_scope: VERTICAL first (9:16 1080x1920). 16:9 needs native widescreen frames from the director; reframe plan in the production sheet.
license_plate: BBY TIGR visible in S13 frame 0.

shots.desc: Arrival: Ferrari settles at the curb outside Val Cruz BOUTIQUE
shots.prompt: Low-angle shot. The yellow hardtop coupe rolls the last few inches to a stop at the curb and settles on its suspension. Palm fronds sway gently, neon reflections shimmer on the wet pavement, people stroll in the far background. Slow push-in toward the car. Keep identity, wardrobe, car geometry (fixed hardtop roof) and cel-shaded graphic-novel style exactly as the start frame. Exactly two arms and two hands per person. No other cars, no new people, no duplicated props, no new text.
flags: Source is a 662x1182 JPEG: upscales soft to 1080x1920. Ask for the full-res original.
